# Glossary: the words of a story, and where they are in the suite

The words on the site's links (what a BA writes in a story) and the page class and method each leads
to. From the crawl: the header and footer links, links between pages, and the page types' names.

| Words in a story | Page class | How a test gets there |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Xove Consulting Services | SiteDetailPage2 | `navigateTo().xoveConsultingServices()` from any page, in the header |
| About Xove | SiteDetailPage3 | `navigateTo().aboutXove()` from any page, in the header |
| Xove Services | SiteDetailPage | `navigateTo().xoveServices()` from any page, in the header |
| App Development | SiteDetailPage | `navigateTo().appDevelopment()` from any page, in the footer |
| E2E QA Services | SiteDetailPage4 | `navigateTo().e2eQaServices()` from any page, in the footer |
| Consulting Services | SiteDetailPage | `navigateTo().consultingServices()` from any page, in the footer |
| NexGen Technologies | SiteDetailPage3 | `navigateTo().nexGenTechnologies()` from any page, in the footer |
| Niche Staffing Services | SiteDetailPage4 | `navigateTo().nicheStaffingServices()` from any page, in the footer |
| Industries | SiteDetailPage2 | `navigateTo().industries()` from any page, in the header |
| Engagement Models | SiteDetailPage3 | `navigateTo().engagementModels()` from any page, in the header |
| Careers | CareersPage | `navigateTo().careers()` from any page, in the header |
| Contact Xove | /contact.php (not read by the crawl) | `navigateTo().contactXove()` from any page, in the header |
| Home | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()` |
| Site Detail | SiteDetailPage | `new SiteDetailPage(page).open("consulting-services.php")` |
| Site Detail2 | SiteDetailPage2 | `new SiteDetailPage2(page).open("index.php")` |
| Site Detail3 | SiteDetailPage3 | `new SiteDetailPage3(page).open("about.php")` |
| Site Detail4 | SiteDetailPage4 | `new SiteDetailPage4(page).open("e2eqaservices.php")` |
| Careers | CareersPage | `new CareersPage(page).open()` |
